scope: Independent original-resolution pixel, source and broad botanical plausibility review; no import or page changes.

entries.alt: Fresh green lobed leaves unfold around a fig branch tip, with fine hairs and veins catching the sunlight.
entries.caption: Tender leaves unfold at the tip of the fig branch. Jesus draws on this familiar sign of approaching summer to teach His hearers to pay attention.
findings: Exact original inspected at full resolution. Recognizably lobed fig leaves, palmate veins, fine hairs, green new growth and gray-brown older wood plausibly depict spring leaf emergence.
No external fig blossoms, ripe fruit, clock, date or invented diagram. Central folded new leaf reads as growth rather than a flower.
Macro light, focus falloff, bark texture and leaf translucence are photographic. Detailed plant structure is visually plausible, not a scientific cultivar certification.
Matthew24:32 directly supports tender branch and leaves as summer-near comparison; caption does not extrapolate a prophetic date.

entries.alt: Two travelers pause on a rocky hillside path beside a spreading leafy fig tree, with other green trees across the slope.
entries.caption: In this imagined scene, travelers pause beside a leafy fig tree and notice the green hillside. Jesus asks His hearers to observe the fig tree and other trees, recognizing summer's approach from their growth.
findings: Exact original inspected at full resolution. Broad lobed foliage, irregular spreading crown and pale branching trunk are plausible fig characteristics; surrounding green deciduous growth supports seasonal observation.
Two unnamed observers are minor figures with natural standing posture, coherent sandals, hands and walking stick; faces are not presented as identifiable biblical people or Christ.
Scene expands from leaf detail01 to landscape observation; it does not purport to be the same photographed branch/tree or an exact elapsed time.
Travelers are interpretive staging, not a recorded Luke21 encounter. Caption explicitly preserves that distinction and includes all-trees context.

No prophecy chart, calendar, invented fruitfulness outcome or claim that a precise date can be read from leaves. Full canopy is illustrative seasonal greenery rather than a scientific calendar marker.
